name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A stack of sections with heading triggers that open one at a time, or several with multiple; the panel fades in.
usage: Use Accordion for a list of sections a user reads or edits one at a time: settings groups, FAQ-style help, the parts of a long connection form. Compose Accordion > AccordionItem (value) > AccordionTrigger + AccordionPanel. defaultValue and value are arrays of open values; multiple lets several stay open. For a single optional block use Collapsible; for views the user switches between, use Tabs.

props.name: variant
props.description: plain separates sections by rules; outline frames them in a bordered surface.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the open values when a section opens or closes.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Several sections may be open at once.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every section (AccordionItem takes disabled for one).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: item
slots.description: One section, ruled off from the next; data-slot="accordion-item", data-open, data-disabled.

slots.name: header
slots.description: The heading around the trigger; data-slot="accordion-header".

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The full-width toggle in text.body-strong; data-slot="accordion-trigger", data-panel-open.

slots.name: chevron
slots.description: The chevron, turned while open; data-slot="accordion-chevron".

parts.name: AccordionItem
parts.description: One section; value identifies it, disabled turns it off.

parts.name: AccordionTrigger
parts.description: The heading and toggle: an <h3> with a full-width button and a chevron.

parts.name: AccordionPanel
parts.description: The section's content, shown while open.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a trigger: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: entering
states.description: The panel fades in from opacity 0.

states.name: leaving
states.description: The panel fades out to opacity 0.

accessibility: Each trigger is a <button> inside an <h3>, with aria-expanded and aria-controls naming its panel; Enter and Space toggle it.
Triggers are native buttons in the tab order; Tab and Shift+Tab move between them. Base UI's Accordion has no arrow-key navigation between headers (optional in the ARIA accordion pattern).
The panel is a region labelled by its trigger and is removed from the DOM while closed.
The chevron is aria-hidden; the state is announced through aria-expanded. Its turn stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
